A_EXTRACTION.label: Step A: Fact Structuring
A_EXTRACTION.title: [A_EXTRACTION] Unstructured text structuring & key fact extraction
A_EXTRACTION.objective: Correct typos in unstructured raw text or media-extracted text and separate fact original text (fact_content) from metadata (attributes).
A_EXTRACTION.output: HierarchicalFactSchema (Corrected facts, summary, key keyword array)
A_EXTRACTION.hint: If the entity exists in master data, instruct to strictly map it to 'ref_entity_id_1'.

B_PLANNING.label: Step B: Log Agent Explorer
B_PLANNING.title: [B_PLANNING] AI Tool Calling (Planning) for Short-term Log
B_PLANNING.objective: Read the provided summary to write today's log and autonomously judge if more 'master data' or 'detailed fact texts' are needed.
B_PLANNING.input: Today's event summary (Index), related external structured data, past history summary
B_PLANNING.hint: Instruct strictly to use the 'SUFFICIENT_INFO' tool if no tool call is deemed necessary.

B_SYNTHESIS.label: Step B: Final Log Synthesis
B_SYNTHESIS.title: [B_SYNTHESIS] Final short-term log synthesis based on agent-fetched data
B_SYNTHESIS.objective: Cross-validate searched past memories, external structured data, and detailed fact texts to derive the final log and action items.
B_SYNTHESIS.input: Summary (Index), [Agent Fetched Data (Facts, Master)], [External Structured Data]
B_SYNTHESIS.output: ContextSynthesisSchema (Final summary text and Action Items array)
B_SYNTHESIS.hint: Clarify words like '[External Structured Data]', '[Agent Fetched Data]' in the prompt to instruct the AI clearly.

C_PLANNING.label: Step C: Report Explorer
C_PLANNING.title: [C_PLANNING] AI Tool Calling for In-depth Summary Report
C_PLANNING.objective: Analyze the user's query (purpose) and cherry-picked core memories to explore additional detailed data needed for the report.
C_PLANNING.input: User Query, Selected memory summary (Index), External structured data
C_PLANNING.hint: Instruct to call the 'FETCH_FACT_DETAILS' tool without hesitation if necessary for a professional report.

C_BRIEFING.label: Step C: Report Writing
C_BRIEFING.title: [C_BRIEFING] Final In-depth AI Summary Report Writing
C_BRIEFING.objective: Synthesize all contexts and fetched detailed facts to write an in-depth report (Briefing) to perfectly answer the user's query.
C_BRIEFING.input: User Query, Summary (Index), [Agent Fetched Data], [External Structured Data]
C_BRIEFING.output: EventBriefingSchema (Exec Summary, Key Findings, Risk/Warnings, Actions)
C_BRIEFING.hint: Strictly control to specify contradictions in 'risk_and_warnings' without inventing facts.

C_CREATIVE.label: Step C: 2nd Creation Engine
C_CREATIVE.title: [C_CREATIVE] Tone & Manner Recreation based on Saved Facts
C_CREATIVE.objective: Reconstruct the text to fit a specific tone and manner without damaging the original data.
C_CREATIVE.input: Original outputs like short-term logs, in-depth reports, etc.
C_CREATIVE.hint: Control max_length so the output does not become excessively long or short.
